reviewScope: Read-only source and local fake-process tests; no ADB, device, Native, build, toolchain, network or host activity.
checks: Only choose_downloads changed in e2e-android.py; bytes before and after that method match HEAD.
Early admission is evaluated only while no native roots list is present.
Admission requires exactly one native file list and exactly one breadcrumb named Downloads or Download, both from the same native package.
Heading/title-only, foreign-package and mixed-native-package evidence cannot satisfy admission.
Multiple breadcrumbs or file lists cannot satisfy admission; visible subfolder breadcrumbs are rejected.
Any roots drawer retains the existing navigation path, and ambiguous drawers still fail before tapping.
The branch calls remaining() and does not change phase or total deadlines, action counts or later file selection.
Already-at-Downloads trace retains the exact source hierarchy and breadcrumb attributes; no tap is requested.
All 35 DownloadsNavigationTests passed with subprocess APIs guarded against real process execution.
Tests include delayed picker mounting, late ready hierarchies, phase/total deadlines and unchanged legacy routes.
limits: This branch recognizes the observed native location presentation; it is not independent filesystem or provider identity attestation.
The subfolder negative demonstrates rejection when multiple breadcrumbs are exposed. It does not prove every possible native breadcrumb truncation or provider presentation.
The existing nonce filename selection, complete imported board identity, source bytes and later artifact checks remain necessary.
No Native006 behavior is qualified by this review.
